And going out to meet his kinsman,
And they saluted each other with peaceful words.
And when he had arrived at the tent,
narravit Moyses cognato suo cuncta quæ fecerat Dominus Pharaoni et Ægyptiis propter Israël:
Moses explained to his kinsman all that the Lord had done to Pharaoh

and all the hardships which had befallen them on the journey,
and how the Lord had freed them.
Lætatusque est Jethro super omnibus bonis, quæ fecerat Dominus Israëli,
And Jethro was gladdened over all the good that the Lord had done for Israel,
eo quod eruisset eum de manu Ægyptiorum.
because he had rescued them from the hand of the Egyptians.

Altera autem die sedit Moyses ut judicaret populum,
Then, the next day, Moses sat down in order to judge the people,
qui assistebat Moysi a mane usque ad vesperam.
and they stood beside Moses from morning, even until evening.
omnia scilicet quæ agebat in populo, ait:
his kinsman saw all that he did among the people, he said:
Quid est hoc quod facis in plebe?
“What is this that you do among the people?
et omnis populus præstolatur de mane usque ad vesperam?
while all the people stand before you, from morning, even until evening?”
Venit ad me populus quærens sententiam Dei:
“The people come to me seeking the verdict of God.
And when any kind of dispute occurs among them,
veniunt ad me ut judicem inter eos,
they come to me to judge between them,
and to reveal the precepts of God
You will be consumed by foolish efforts,
et populus iste qui tecum est:
both you and this people who are with you.
The task is beyond your strength;
you will not be able bear it alone.
Sed audi verba mea atque consilia,
But listen to my words and counsels,
and then God will be with you.
Esto tu populo in his quæ ad Deum pertinent,
Be available to the people in that which pertains to God,
ut referas quæ dicuntur ad eum:
so as to refer what they say to him,
and to reveal to the people the ceremonies,
and the way by which they should progress,
and the work that they should do.
Provide autem de omni plebe viros potentes,
in whom there is truth and who hate avarice,
who may judge the people at all times. Then,
when anything greater will have occurred,
they may refer it to you,

And so it may be lighter for you,
the burden being divided among others.
you will fulfill the orders of God,

et omnis hic populus revertetur ad loca sua cum pace.
